label: Diabetes prevalence
rationale: Marker of chronic disease burden; strongly associated with ED utilization and preventable hospitalizations

label: Life expectancy (inverted)
rationale: Summary measure of population health; low life expectancy indicates systemic health disadvantage.

label: PCP rate (inverted, shortage)
rationale: Primary care physician supply; shortage forces reliance on emergency departments for routine care.

label: Poverty rate
rationale: Economic deprivation limits access to preventive care, healthy food, and stable housing.

label: Physical inactivity
rationale: Modifiable behavioral risk factor upstream of diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and obesity.
